mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS MoM > 300,000.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% month-over-month and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) also increase, it signals strong demand in both housing and consumer sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST MoM > 10% and RSAFS MoM > 0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ < -1%.
